scope: Bounded test-only production Chromium keys-only preference recovery driver and reader copy; G07 recovery/private local Following and Bookmarks support.
inspection: Exact accessor-free detached control schema; canonical owner-only encrypted backup validation precedes browser use; all validation errors projected to fixed message.
Expected public post values are Node-side assertions and locators only, never application or preference state injection.
Fresh Chromium/native IndexedDB, real production Unlock/import/recovery UI and explicit bounded continuation; partial recovery cannot qualify private content.

Only three loopback origins allowed. Fixed public feed/board queries and static routes; installed SDK read/simulation inventory only; unknown or malformed RPC, expanded public query, proof/submission methods and WebSockets prevent pass.
No response bodies, request parameters, URLs, arbitrary errors, backup material or expected content included in returned report.
Actual DOM assertions require recovered Following, Bookmarks and main-board follow state; lock and reload must erase private presentation and avoid further private/feed traffic.
Timeout and cleanup failure prevent pass. Context and browser close precede final counter snapshot/reassertion; parent owns process/resource supervision and endpoint lifetimes.
Reader change is visible copy plus matching assertion; no pagination or network behavior change.

checks.kind: independent cheap tests; no Chromium launched

requiredBeforeRuntime: Review exact parent composition, immutable backup lifetime and current built assets.
Parent must reserve at least 150 seconds for the <=120 second browser within unchanged 540 second / 4 GiB owned-tree budget.

Parent must independently authenticate canonical setup/preferences and reconcile actual receiver/proof/submission counters and both relevant fee/accounting results after browser shutdown and before acknowledgement.
Final affected reader browser assertion still requires its granted browser slot; this review did not run Chromium.
limitations: Traffic validator inspects request boundaries, not response status/body or full identifier/HMAC unlinkability. Successful DOM recovery and parent counters are separate required evidence.
No pending/completion receiver accounting is supplied by this driver itself.
Synthetic control/traffic tests are not genuine encrypted browser recovery, real chain, notification, reorg or full privacy acceptance.
